letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my endless sunshine,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still grin thinking of the way you laughed at my terrible jokes on our wedding day, and I cherish every quiet evening we steal together now. You are my cutie, my confidante, my forever home—no matter the city, my heart beats only for you. Thank you for making each day feel like a celebration of love.
poem:
In desert dunes or river’s flow,  
Your smile’s the map where I will go.  
Through spice-scented nights we sway,  
My love for you grows brighter each day.
